featured_reviews.name: Usharani Yandrapu
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Child Help Foundation is an organization that focuses on supporting children who are in need. It works to improve the lives of children by providing access to education, healthcare, and basic necessities. The foundation often helps children from disadvantaged backgrounds, including those who are orphaned, abandoned, or living in difficult family situations. It also organizes programs and activities to promote overall child development, including skill-building, counseling, and health check-ups. They provide educational support, like tutoring, school supplies, and scholarships, to help children continue their studies. They organize health check-ups, vaccination drives, and basic medical care to ensure children stay healthy. They also run awareness programs about hygiene, nutrition, and safety. The foundation often arranges recreational and creative activities, like art, sports, and cultural events, so children can develop skills, confidence, and social interaction.Beach cleanups are awesome ways to give back to the environment and community. Many organizations, including some like the Child Help Foundation, often participate in or support environmental initiatives like beach cleanups. These events help raise awareness about pollution, protect marine life, and keep our beaches clean and safe.
The goal of the foundation is to ensure that every child gets a chance to grow up in a safe environment with opportunities to learn, stay healthy, and build a better future.

featured_reviews.name: INDU KOLATI
featured_reviews.review_text:
In My Words – About Child Help Foundation:

Child Help Foundation is a service organization that moves forward with a kind heart. It supports underprivileged children by helping them with health, education, food, and overall development, working to build a brighter future for them. The foundation believes that even a small contribution can bring a big change. Through their work, they have brought light into the lives of thousands of children. Seeing this kind of positive impact inspires a sense of service in us too. If we want to be part of real change in society, it’s important to support such organizations. With a presence in multiple states, including Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and others, the organization focuses on emergency medical support, holistic education programs, and community development initiatives. CHF has made a significant impact, saving over 4,226 children through its Emergency Medical Programme and providing access to quality education to 104,670 underprivileged children. Their initiatives include Baby Feeding Centres, Arogya Sadan (a facility for patients traveling for treatment), and the Swastha Se Shiksha Programme, which bridges the gap between health recovery and continued education. With a team of over 100 employees and a network of volunteers, CHF relies on donations to continue its mission to empower underprivileged children and create positive change in their lives

featured_reviews.name: Ganesh bidkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My 24-month journey with Child Help Foundation has been an incredible experience filled with compassion, purpose, and countless unforgettable memories. Over these two years, I have been blessed to be part of several beautiful initiatives — from tree plantation drives that gave new life to the earth, to the Zero Hunger campaign that brought food and hope to those who needed it the most.

One of the most emotional moments for me was being part of the baby sack distribution at Kamla Nehru Hospital. Holding those tiny bundles of life, seeing the smiles of new mothers, and feeling the warmth of gratitude in their eyes made me realize how powerful small acts of kindness can be. Each effort, each moment spent helping others, felt like planting seeds of love and humanity.
Today I reached a old lady she was very kind and humanity she give blessings 🙏..

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Aiyesha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Team of the Child Health Foundation,

I am writing to share my personal feedback and gratitude for giving us the opportunity to participate in cheering for the athletes at the Tata Marathon held at Churchgate Marine Drive. As a student of Royal College, it was an enriching and memorable experience for me.

The energy at the event was contagious, and it was truly inspiring to see the determination and resilience of the marathon runners. Being part of the group that came together to cheer them on was a unique and rewarding experience. The joy of encouraging the athletes, clapping, and shouting words of motivation as they passed by made me feel like I was contributing to their journey, even if in a small way.

One of the most unforgettable moments was when we danced and sang along the sidelines to uplift the runners' spirits. Seeing their smiles and receiving waves of acknowledgment from them was heartwarming. It made me realize how much our presence as supporters meant to them during their challenging run.

This experience not only allowed me to be part of an incredible event but also gave me a deeper appreciation for the power of community support. The effort and organization behind our gathering were commendable, and I am grateful to the Child Health Foundation for enabling us to witness and participate in such a meaningful occasion.

Thank you for this wonderful opportunity to be involved in a cause that promotes health, perseverance, and togetherness. I look forward to supporting similar initiatives in the future.

Warm regards,
Shaikh Aiyesha Abdul Ahad

featured_reviews.name: Maizen3555
featured_reviews.review_text:
Goonj is a distinctive NGO that focuses on sustainable development through the reuse of urban surplus. In Mumbai, they collect old clothes, shoes, toys, stationery, and other usable items. These items are carefully sorted, washed, and recycled into useful kits like Family Kits, Student Kits, sanitary pads, wedding kits, and more.

The production work is mainly carried out by women from remote or underprivileged communities, providing them with income and dignity. Goonj pays these women fairly, empowering them economically and socially.

The kits are not distributed as charity but exchanged in return for community service or provided in disaster-affected areas. This model respects the dignity of the receiver and encourages active participation.

The people at Goonj are extremely courteous, committed, and helpful. Special thanks to Himanshu Kulkarni and Himanshu Khemka, who took the time to warmly explain the functioning of the organisation. Goonj stands as a shining example of how empathy and innovation can lead to meaningful social change.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Adarsh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A few months ago, a close friend’s child was diagnosed with a serious illness, and the family was overwhelmed—emotionally and financially. In the midst of their search for help, someone recommended the Child Health Care and Educational Foundation. That introduction turned out to be a turning point.
From the very first interaction, it was clear that this wasn’t just another organization. The team truly listened, offered guidance without judgment, and acted with genuine care. They helped the family understand the treatment options, supported them in navigating the hospital system, and even provided educational resources to make sure the child didn’t fall behind in school during recovery.
What really stood out was how human the whole experience felt. This wasn’t about paperwork or ticking boxes—it was about people helping people, heart to heart.
Beyond just health care, the foundation also runs awareness drives in schools, helps educate communities, and makes early detection a priority—proving that prevention is just as important as treatment.
Thanks to their support, that child is now on a path to recovery. And for the family, they’ll always remember the kindness and support they received during one of the hardest times of their lives.
If you’re looking to support a cause that truly changes lives, this NGO is doing just that—quietly, consistently, and with a lot of heart.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Adarsh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wasn’t directly involved, but I closely witnessed how Cancer Control Mission stepped in to support someone I know—a distant relative of a colleague, a young girl battling cancer with limited financial means.
Her family was devastated—emotionally drained and unable to afford the long-term treatment she needed. They had tried everything, but help seemed out of reach. That’s when Cancer Control Mission came into the picture.
They didn’t just offer words—they offered action. Within a short time, they arranged for medical consultations, helped cover part of the treatment costs, and stayed in constant touch with the family to ensure no step of the process felt overwhelming.
I watched, from the sidelines, how this organization became a lifeline. What really impressed me was how responsive and human their team was. No red tape, no long waiting lists—just immediate, focused help when it mattered most.
Their work often goes unnoticed, but for families fighting the silent and painful battle of cancer, organizations like this are the quiet heroes in the background. They make the impossible feel a little more possible.
If you’re considering supporting a cause or are in need of help, Cancer Control Mission is doing impactful, grassroots work with sincerity and care. They might not always be in the spotlight—but they are exactly where they need to be: beside the ones who need them most.
